question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city,
         t.calendar_year,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
city_comparison AS (
  SELECT 
    q2019.cust_city
  FROM city_sales q2019
  JOIN city_sales q2020 ON q2019.cust_city = q2020.cust_city
  WHERE q2019.calendar_year = 2019 AND q2020.calendar_year = 2020
    AND q2020.total_sales >= q2019.total_sales * 1.20
),
target_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cust_city FROM city_comparison
),
product_total_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_product_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM target_cities)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id,
         total_product_sales,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_product_sales DESC) as rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
  FROM product_total_sales
),
top_20pct AS (
  SELECT prod_id
  FROM ranked_products
  WHERE rn <= CAST(total_count * 0.2 AS INTEGER)
),
quarter_totals AS (
  SELECT t.calendar_year,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_quarter_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM target_cities)
  GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id,
         t.calendar_year,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM target_cities)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
)
SELECT 
  tp.prod_id,
  ROUND(pq2019.product_sales * 1.0 / qt2019.total_quarter_sales, 6) as share_2019,
  ROUND(pq2020.product_sales * 1.0 / qt2020.total_quarter_sales, 6) as share_2020,
  ROUND((pq2020.product_sales * 1.0 / qt2020.total_quarter_sales) - (pq2019.product_sales * 1.0 / qt2019.total_quarter_sales), 6) as share_change
FROM top_20pct tp
JOIN product_quarter_sales pq2019 ON tp.prod_id = pq2019.prod_id AND pq2019.calendar_year = 2019
JOIN product_quarter_sales pq2020 ON tp.prod_id = pq2020.prod_id AND pq2020.calendar_year = 2020
JOIN quarter_totals qt2019 ON qt2019.calendar_year = 2019
JOIN quarter_totals qt2020 ON qt2020.calendar_year = 2020
ORDER BY share_change DESC
